QuestInfo.name: Alien Stone
QuestInfo.0: #p3000018#'s grumbling around again. Might as well see what he needs.
QuestInfo.1: #p3000018# needs more Essence Stones for... dragony reasons. You were going to say no, but he gave you that nice gift. Defeat the #o4230117# aliens at the #m221040200# in Omega Sector and get him a #t4033442#.
QuestInfo.2: #p3000018# thanked you, but it wasn't a big deal.

0.0: Sooo, what did you think of that super cool emblem I gave you, #h0#.\r\n#L0##bHonestly, I thought it was tacky it at first, but now I think it's great!#l\n#k
0.1: Y-you have got to learn some manners. But I'm glad you enjoyed it. So while we're on the subject of liking things, I have some very strong opinions about Essence Stones. \r\n#L0##bOkay! #l\n#k
0.2: Really?! No sassy comeback? No cutting down my male ego? \r\n#L0##bYou've been really nice to me Eskie, most of the time. I like doing things for you. That's how friendships work, even between men and women. #l\n#k
0.3: I KNEW that gift was a winner. Go get me a stone from Omega Sector on the double, dragon-slave! There is an alien called #o4230117# there that I would most like to consume.

yes.0: I am going to eat a rock from space! If only mommy could see her boy now...

no.0: Oh, now you're all against me.

1.0: Wow, this Essence Stone looks really delicious. I'll eat it with relish!

yes.0: Surprisingly piquant! I think I just ate a space worm, though.

item.0: Go to the #m221040200# near the Omega Sector and bring me a #t4033442# from one of those #o4230117# alien... things.
